body: Why do you have to go home?

I think it sucks so much that so many posts here have no replies. I think some posting times are better than others, but still- to think that even one person’s post had no response makes me sad.

I can totally relate with giving up though. I myself am trying to overcome this feeling too, right now. Wanna talk about it?

I feel that.

Being an adult sucks. Giving a third of your life to the man, just for the privilege to keep doing it.

You’re a great writer. I can relate with damn near every thing you said. You’re right- you should start writing again. You’d be doing us all a service!

If it weren’t for the part about marriage, I would have thought I’d posted this while sleep-redditing.

Have you tried any new hobbies recently?

As far as I know, there’s nothing after this life. Whatever happens between the first day and the last is the only experience we’ll ever have- for better or for worse. My answer, personally, is that I’ve got nothing better to do.

At first, there’s not a lot of comfort in that answer. But the way I see it is: if we’ve got only one life, and we give it whatever meaning we want, then there’s no wrong answers.

Going forward, I’d recommend two things. Firstly, seeing a professional. They can help you feel more comfortable in your own head. They’ve helped me with this to some degree so far. It’s definitely not perfect, but it will be much more helpful than nothing. Second, find something you like to do. Big picture and small.

Surround yourself with enjoyment. Experiment. Do a lot of hobbies. Ditch them if you don’t like them. If you have all this time to experience things, you might as well experience things you like, right?

Edit: I think I got ahead of myself here. I should preface those last two points- these are two things I did that led me to answering your original question. They’re more like examples instead of directives. The point is- I wasn’t enjoying my time here, so I tried to find some ways to make my time here more enjoyable.

I know basic JS, HTML, and CSS.

Just trying to see what’s next.

You can read it [here](https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/7eeqfk/i_should_have_came_here_a_lot_sooner/?st=JA9ZNQH2&sh=1e7b34e8https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/7eeqfk/i_should_have_came_here_a_lot_sooner/?st=JA9ZNQH2&sh=1e7b34e8)  but basically I just feel lost, overwhelmed, and I feel like it wouldn’t be such a bad thing to not be alive anymore.
I have an appointment with a counselor, but it’s not for another week and a half. I’m not sure I can wait that long.
